name: Ring of the Iron Liver (Least Minor Ring)
body:
Aura faint conjuration (healing); CL 1st; Slot ring; Price 600 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

Adorned with a skull and crossbones, this ring smells slightly of rum.

EFFECTS

A ring of the iron liver provides the wearer a continuous +1 competence bonus to saves against poison and drugs, and a +2 competence bonus to saves against the effects of alcohol.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring or Ring Apprentice; Spells remove sickness; Cost 300 gp.
